sentences.en: I see the sun with my eyes.
I hear music with my ears.
I can touch the soft cloth.

sentences.zh: 我尝到了甜苹果的味道。

sentences.en: I smell the flower with my nose.
The bed is soft and warm.
The stone is hard and cold.
My coat is wet from the rain.
The sun feels warm on my skin.
sentences.zh: 太阳照在我的皮肤上感觉很温暖。

sentences.en: I hear the sound of a bird.
The attention of the class was on the teacher.
sentences.zh: 全班的注意力都在老师身上。

sentences.en: The attraction of the music was strong.
I take a deep breath of fresh air.
sentences.zh: 我深深吸了一口新鲜空气。
